name: barbell zercher back extension
description: Holding a barbell in the crook of your elbows, you hinge and extend the back. It loads the lower back, glutes and core.
instructions: Hold the barbell in the crook of your elbows against your chest.
Set up on a back extension bench with your hips on the pad.
Lower your torso with a flat back until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Raise your torso until your body is in a straight line.
Use a light weight and control the bar.
